author: Aetherbeen
quote: This is not GTA, it feels more like The Sims. You can tell modern feminism completely poisoned this game, and it is a shame. You can tell women worked on the story because it is so soft and uninteresting that you might just fall asleep out of boredom. People have relationships irl, and the ones who do not mostly do not want them, so why would you force them into a relationship in a game with AI? It should be a side thing, and the player should have the option to tell Lucia to **** off because that is where she belongs based on her character. If a person like that existed, I would hate her.
